metadata.description: The Money Page skills — pick the right money page for your product, then build it in your Shopify store with AI.

plugins.name: money-page-skills
plugins.description: Two skills from The Money Page playbook by DTC Daily: pick-your-money-page (researches your store and recommends which of the 7 money page types to build) and build-your-money-page (drafts the copy and creates the page in your Shopify store, unpublished, via the official connector).
